<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>SOS Ansiedade no Trabalho</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;1,300&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tabler/icons-webfont@2.30.0/tabler-icons.min.css">
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
body{font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;background:#F2F7F5;display:flex;min-height:100vh;color:#2C3E50}
.sidebar{width:220px;min-width:220px;background:#fff;border-right:0.5px solid #C9E0D8;display:flex;flex-direction:column;position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;overflow-y:auto}
.logo-box{padding:20px 16px 14px;border-bottom:0.5px solid #C9E0D8;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.logo-box img{width:84px;height:84px;object-fit:contain}
.logo-sub{font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#9B8EC4;text-transform:uppercase;text-align:center;line-height:1.5}
.sidebar-quote{margin:12px 12px 4px;padding:10px 12px;background:#EEF6F2;border-radius:8px;border-left:2px solid #9DCFB8;font-size:10.5px;color:#4A8070;font-style:italic;line-height:1.5}
.nav-section{padding:10px 0 4px}
.nav-label{font-size:9px;color:#B5BEC8;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:0 16px;margin-bottom:4px}
.nav-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:9px 16px;font-size:13px;color:#5A6474;cursor:pointer;border-left:2px solid transparent;transition:all .15s}
.nav-item:hover{background:#F0F7F4;color:#3A6B5A}
.nav-item.active{background:#E8F5EE;color:#2E8B6A;border-left-color:#5DCAA5;font-weight:500}
.nav-item i{font-size:16px;width:18px;flex-shrink:0}
.nav-div{height:0.5px;background:#E6EEEB;margin:8px 16px}
.user-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:12px 16px 16px;border-top:0.5px solid #E6EEEB;margin-top:auto}
.avatar{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:#E1F5EE;border:1.5px solid #9DCFB8;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:#0F6E56;flex-shrink:0}
.user-name{font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:#3A6B5A}
.user-sub{font-size:10px;color:#9DCFB8}
.main{flex:1;padding:24px;overflow:auto}
.page{display:none}.page.active{display:block}
.page-title{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:22px;font-weight:400;color:#2C3E50;margin:0 0 4px}
.page-sub{font-size:12px;color:#8A9BAA;margin-bottom:20px}
.card{background:#fff;border-radius:12px;border:0.5px solid #C9E0D8;padding:16px 18px;margin-bottom:14px}
.card-title{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:500;color:#2C3E50;margin:0 0 12px}
.stat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(110px,1fr));gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px}
.stat-card{background:#F2F7F5;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;text-align:center}
.stat-val{font-size:24px;font-weight:500;color:#2E8B6A}
.stat-lbl{font-size:10.5px;color:#8A9BAA;margin-top:2px}
.quote-box{background:#EEEDFE;border-radius:10px;padding:16px 18px;border-left:3px solid #9B8EC4;margin-bottom:16px}
.quote-text{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:15px;color:#3C3489;font-style:italic;line-height:1.7}
.quote-author{font-size:11px;color:#9B8EC4;margin-top:6px}
.feature-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(140px,1fr));gap:10px}
.feature-tile{background:#fff;border-radius:12px;border:0.5px solid #C9E0D8;padding:14px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s}
.feature-tile:hover{border-color:#9DCFB8;background:#F8FCFA;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.feature-icon{font-size:22px;color:#5DCAA5;margin-bottom:8px}
.feature-icon.lav{color:#9B8EC4}
.feature-name{font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:#2C3E50}
.feature-desc{font-size:11px;color:#8A9BAA;margin-top:2px}
.mood-bar{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px}
.mood-btn{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid #C9E0D8;background:#F8FAFA;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:#5A6474;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:all .15s}
.mood-btn:hover,.mood-btn.sel{background:#9DCFB8;border-color:#5DCAA5;color:#085041}
.chip{padding:5px 12px;border-radius:20px;font-size:12px;border:0.5px solid #C4B5D9;color:#534AB7;background:#EEEDFE;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;display:inline-block;margin:3px}
.chip:hover,.chip.sel{background:#C4B5D9;color:#26215C}
.btn-p{background:#5DCAA5;color:#04342C;border:none;padding:10px 20px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s}
.btn-p:hover{background:#1D9E75;color:#fff}
.btn-g{background:transparent;color:#5A6474;border:0.5px solid #C9E0D8;padding:9px 16px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s}
.btn-g:hover{background:#F0F7F4}
textarea,input[type=text]{width:100%;border:0.5px solid #C9E0D8;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:13px;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;color:#2C3E50;background:#FAFCFB;outline:none;resize:vertical}
textarea:focus,input[type=text]:focus{border-color:#9DCFB8}
textarea{min-height:100px;display:block}
input[type=text]{min-height:auto;resize:none;margin-bottom:10px}
.diary-entry{border-bottom:0.5px solid #EEF2F0;padding:12px 0;display:flex;gap:12px}
.d-date{font-size:10.5px;color:#9DCFB8;min-width:46px;text-align:center;padding-top:2px}
.d-day{font-size:19px;font-weight:500;color:#2E8B6A;display:block}
.d-text{font-size:12.5px;color:#5A6474;line-height:1.6;flex:1}
.d-tag{display:inline-block;font-size:10px;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:10px;background:#EEEDFE;color:#534AB7;margin:2px}
.tech-card{background:#F2F7F5;border-radius:10px;border:0.5px solid #C9E0D8;padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:10px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.tech-card:hover,.tech-card.sel{border-color:#5DCAA5;background:#E8F5EE}
.tech-name{font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:#2C3E50}
.tech-desc{font-size:11px;color:#8A9BAA;margin-top:2px}
.tech-badge{font-size:10.5px;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:12px;background:#EEEDFE;color:#534AB7;white-space:nowrap}
.breath-wrap{text-align:center;padding:8px 0}
.breath-circle{width:120px;height:120px;border-radius:50%;background:#E1F5EE;border:2px solid #5DCAA5;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:0 auto 16px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:#0F6E56;transition:transform .3s}
.breath-phase{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:18px;color:#2E8B6A;margin-bottom:6px}
.breath-count{font-size:32px;font-weight:500;color:#1D9E75}
.breath-inst{font-size:12px;color:#8A9BAA;margin-bottom:16px}
.art-card{border-bottom:0.5px solid #EEF2F0;padding:12px 0;display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start}
.art-icon{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:8px;background:#E1F5EE;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;color:#0F6E56;font-size:18px}
.art-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:#2C3E50;margin-bottom:3px}
.art-prev{font-size:11.5px;color:#8A9BAA;line-height:1.5}
.art-cat{font-size:10px;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:10px;background:#E1F5EE;color:#0F6E56;margin-top:5px;display:inline-block}
.filter-row{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:14px}
.filter-btn{padding:5px 14px;border-radius:20px;font-size:12px;border:0.5px solid #C9E0D8;color:#5A6474;cursor:pointer;background:#fff;transition:all .15s}
.filter-btn:hover,.filter-btn.active{background:#E1F5EE;border-color:#9DCFB8;color:#0F6E56}
.goal-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:0.5px solid #F0F4F2}
.goal-check{width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid #9DCFB8;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:11px;color:#fff;transition:all .15s}
.goal-check.done{background:#5DCAA5;border-color:#5DCAA5}
.goal-text{font-size:13px;color:#5A6474;flex:1}
.goal-text.done{text-decoration:line-through;color:#B0B8C4}
.prog-bg{height:6px;background:#E8F5EE;border-radius:3px;margin-top:4px}
.prog-fill{height:6px;background:#5DCAA5;border-radius:3px;transition:width .3s}
.chart-row{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:6px;height:80px;margin-top:10px}
.chart-col{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px}
.chart-bar{width:100%;background:#9DCFB8;border-radius:4px 4px 0 0}
.chart-bar.lav{background:#C4B5D9}
.chart-day{font-size:10px;color:#B0B8C4}
.success-msg{display:none;text-align:center;padding:12px;color:#0F6E56;font-size:13px;background:#E8F5EE;border-radius:8px;margin-top:10px}
.grid2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.insight-box{border-radius:8px;padding:12px}
.insight-box.green{background:#E8F5EE}
.insight-box.lav{background:#EEEDFE}
.insight-lbl{font-size:11px;margin-bottom:4px}
.insight-val{font-size:14px;font-weight:500}
.insight-sub{font-size:11px;margin-top:2px}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="sidebar">
  <div class="logo-box">
    <img id="logo" alt="SOS Ansiedade no Trabalho">
    <div class="logo-sub">Ansiedade<br>no Trabalho</div>
  </div>
  <div class="sidebar-quote" id="sq"></div>

  <div class="nav-section">
    <div class="nav-label">Principal</div>
    <div class="nav-item active" onclick="showPage('home',this)"><i class="ti ti-home"></i> Início</div>
    <div class="nav-item" onclick="showPage('checkin',this)"><i class="ti ti-heart"></i> Check-in Diário</div>
    <div class="nav-item" onclick="showPage('diary',this)"><i class="ti ti-notebook"></i> Diário</div>
  </div>
  <div class="nav-div"></div>
  <div class="nav-section">
    <div class="nav-label">Ferramentas</div>
    <div class="nav-item" onclick="showPage('breathing',this)"><i class="ti ti-wind"></i> Respiração</div>
    <div class="nav-item" onclick="showPage('progress',this)"><i class="ti ti-chart-bar"></i> Progresso</div>
    <div class="nav-item" onclick="showPage('library',this)"><i class="ti ti-books"></i> Biblioteca</div>
    <div class="nav-item" onclick="showPage('goals',this)"><i class="ti ti-target"></i> Metas</div>
  </div>

  <div class="user-row">
    <div class="avatar">U</div>
    <div>
      <div class="user-name">Usuário</div>
      <div class="user-sub">Bem-estar ativo</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="main">

  <!-- INÍCIO -->
  <div class="page active" id="page-home">
    <div class="page-title" id="greeting">Bom dia</div>
    <div class="page-sub" id="home-date"></div>
    <div class="quote-box">
      <div class="quote-text" id="home-quote"></div>
      <div class="quote-author" id="home-author"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-grid">
      <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-val">7</div><div class="stat-lbl">dias seguidos</div></div>
      <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-val" style="color:#9B8EC4">7.2</div><div class="stat-lbl">humor médio</div></div>
      <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-val">3</div><div class="stat-lbl">sessões esta semana</div></div>
      <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-val" style="color:#9B8EC4">4</div><div class="stat-lbl">metas ativas</div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-title">Acesse suas funcionalidades</div>
      <div class="feature-grid">
        <div class="feature-tile" onclick="showPage('checkin',null)">
          <div class="feature-icon"><i class="ti ti-heart"></i></div>
          <div class="feature-name">Check-in</div>
          <div class="feature-desc">Registre seu humor</div>
        </div>
        <div class="feature-tile" onclick="showPage('breathing',null)">
          <div class="feature-icon lav"><i class="ti ti-wind"></i></div>
          <div class="feature-name">Respiração</div>
          <div class="feature-desc">Técnicas guiadas</div>
        </div>
        <div class="feature-tile" onclick="showPage('diary',null)">
          <div class="feature-icon"><i class="ti ti-notebook"></i></div>
          <div class="feature-name">Diário</div>
          <div class="feature-desc">Explore sentimentos</div>
        </div>
        <div class="feature-tile" onclick="showPage('progress',null)">
          <div class="feature-icon lav"><i class="ti ti-chart-bar"></i></div>
          <div class="feature-name">Progresso</div>
          <div class="feature-desc">Sua evolução</div>
        </div>
        <div class="feature-tile" onclick="showPage('library',null)">
          <div class="feature-icon"><i class="ti ti-books"></i></div>
          <div class="feature-name">Biblioteca</div>
          <div class="feature-desc">Artigos e guias</div>
        </div>
        <div class="feature-tile" onclick="showPage('goals',null)">
          <div class="feature-icon lav"><i class="ti ti-target"></i></div>
          <div class="feature-name">Metas</div>
          <div class="feature-desc">Objetivos pessoais</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- CHECK-IN -->
  <div class="page" id="page-checkin">
    <div class="page-title">Check-in Emocional</div>
    <div class="page-sub">Como você está hoje?</div>
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-title">Humor (1–10)</div>
      <div class="mood-bar" id="mood-bar"></div>
      <div id="mood-feedback" style="font-size:12px;color:#9B8EC4;min-height:16px;margin-bottom:10px"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-title">Emoções presentes</div>
      <div id="emotion-chips">
        <span class="chip" onclick="toggleChip(this)">Ansioso</span>
        <span class="chip" onclick="toggleChip(this)">Cansado</span>
        <span class="chip" onclick="toggleChip(this)">Estressado</span>
        <span class="chip" onclick="toggleChip(this)">Tranquilo</span>
        <span class="chip" onclick="toggleChip(this)">Motivado</span>
        <span class="chip" onclick="toggleChip(this)">Sobrecarregado</span>
        <span class="chip" onclick="toggleChip(this)">Grato</span>
        <span class="chip" onclick="toggleChip(this)">Irritado</span>
        <span class="chip" onclick="toggleChip(this)">Esperançoso</span>
        <span class="chip" onclick="toggleChip(this)">Confuso</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-title">Contexto (opcional)</div>
      <textarea id="checkin-ctx" placeholder="O que está influenciando seu estado hoje?"></textarea>
    </div>
    <button class="btn-p" style="width:100%" onclick="saveCheckin()">Salvar check-in</button>
    <div class="success-msg" id="checkin-ok"><i class="ti ti-check" style="vertical-align:-2px;margin-right:4px"></i> Check-in salvo!</div>
    <div class="card" style="margin-top:14px">
      <div class="card-title">Histórico recente</div>
      <div id="checkin-hist"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- DIÁRIO -->
  <div class="page" id="page-diary">
    <div class="page-title">Diário de Emoções</div>
    <div class="page-sub">Espaço seguro para seus sentimentos</div>
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-title">Nova entrada</div>
      <textarea id="diary-txt" placeholder="Escreva livremente sobre seus sentimentos, pensamentos e experiências..."></textarea>
      <div style="margin:10px 0" id="diary-tag-chips">
        <span class="chip" onclick="toggleChip(this)">trabalho</span>
        <span class="chip" onclick="toggleChip(this)">relações</span>
        <span class="chip" onclick="toggleChip(this)">conquista</span>
        <span class="chip" onclick="toggleChip(this)">desafio</span>
        <span class="chip" onclick="toggleChip(this)">reflexão</span>
        <span class="chip" onclick="toggleChip(this)">gratidão</span>
      </div>
      <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:10px">
        <button class="btn-p" onclick="saveDiary()">Salvar entrada</button>
        <button class="btn-g" onclick="document.getElementById('diary-txt').value=''">Limpar</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-title">Entradas anteriores</div>
      <div id="diary-entries"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- RESPIRAÇÃO -->
  <div class="page" id="page-breathing">
    <div class="page-title">Técnicas de Respiração</div>
    <div class="page-sub">Regulação emocional guiada</div>
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-title">Escolha uma técnica</div>
      <div class="tech-card sel" id="tech-478" onclick="selTech('478')">
        <div><div class="tech-name">Respiração 4-7-8</div><div class="tech-desc">Inhale 4s · Segure 7s · Exhale 8s</div></div>
        <span class="tech-badge">Relaxamento</span>
      </div>
      <div class="tech-card" id="tech-box" onclick="selTech('box')">
        <div><div class="tech-name">Box Breathing</div><div class="tech-desc">4s · 4s · 4s · 4s — tática militar</div></div>
        <span class="tech-badge">Foco</span>
      </div>
      <div class="tech-card" id="tech-calm" onclick="selTech('calm')">
        <div><div class="tech-name">Respiração Calmante</div><div class="tech-desc">Inhale 5s · Exhale 7s</div></div>
        <span class="tech-badge">Ansiedade</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="card breath-wrap">
      <div class="breath-circle" id="bcircle">Pronto</div>
      <div class="breath-phase" id="bphase">Escolha e inicie</div>
      <div class="breath-count" id="bcount">—</div>
      <div class="breath-inst" id="binst">Selecione uma técnica acima</div>
      <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;margin-top:12px">
        <button class="btn-p" id="bbtn" onclick="toggleBreath()">Iniciar</button>
        <button class="btn-g" onclick="resetBreath()">Reiniciar</button>
      </div>
      <div style="margin-top:12px;font-size:12px;color:#9B8EC4">Ciclos: <strong style="color:#2E8B6A" id="bcycles">0</strong></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- PROGRESSO -->
  <div class="page" id="page-progress">
    <div class="page-title">Rastreador de Progresso</div>
    <div class="page-sub">Visualize sua evolução emocional</div>
    <div class="stat-grid">
      <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-val">7</div><div class="stat-lbl">dias seguidos</div></div>
      <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-val" style="color:#9B8EC4">7.2</div><div class="stat-lbl">humor médio</div></div>
      <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-val">12</div><div class="stat-lbl">check-ins</div></div>
      <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-val" style="color:#9B8EC4">5</div><div class="stat-lbl">entradas no diário</div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-title">Humor — últimos 7 dias</div>
      <div class="chart-row" id="mood-chart"></div>
      <div style="display:flex;gap:14px;margin-top:10px;font-size:11px;color:#8A9BAA">
        <span style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px"><span style="width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:2px;background:#9DCFB8;display:inline-block"></span>Humor</span>
        <span style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px"><span style="width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:2px;background:#C4B5D9;display:inline-block"></span>Sessões</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-title">Insights da semana</div>
      <div class="grid2">
        <div class="insight-box green">
          <div class="insight-lbl" style="color:#0F6E56">Melhor dia</div>
          <div class="insight-val" style="color:#085041">Quarta-feira</div>
          <div class="insight-sub" style="color:#8A9BAA">Humor: 9/10</div>
        </div>
        <div class="insight-box lav">
          <div class="insight-lbl" style="color:#534AB7">Técnica favorita</div>
          <div class="insight-val" style="color:#3C3489">Box Breathing</div>
          <div class="insight-sub" style="color:#8A9BAA">4 sessões</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- BIBLIOTECA -->
  <div class="page" id="page-library">
    <div class="page-title">Biblioteca Psicoeducativa</div>
    <div class="page-sub">Conteúdo baseado em evidências</div>
    <div class="filter-row">
      <div class="filter-btn active" onclick="filterLib(this,'all')">Todos</div>
      <div class="filter-btn" onclick="filterLib(this,'estresse')">Estresse</div>
      <div class="filter-btn" onclick="filterLib(this,'burnout')">Burnout</div>
      <div class="filter-btn" onclick="filterLib(this,'relacoes')">Relações</div>
      <div class="filter-btn" onclick="filterLib(this,'produtividade')">Produtividade</div>
    </div>
    <div class="card" id="lib-list"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- METAS -->
  <div class="page" id="page-goals">
    <div class="page-title">Plano de Ação</div>
    <div class="page-sub">Seus objetivos de bem-estar</div>
    <div class="card">
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:12px">
        <div class="card-title" style="margin:0">Metas ativas</div>
        <div style="font-size:12px;color:#9DCFB8" id="gp-label">0 / 0</div>
      </div>
      <div class="prog-bg"><div class="prog-fill" id="gp-bar" style="width:0%"></div></div>
      <div style="margin-top:14px" id="goals-list"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-title">Adicionar meta</div>
      <input type="text" id="new-goal" placeholder="Ex: Meditar 10 minutos por dia">
      <button class="btn-p" onclick="addGoal()">Adicionar meta</button>
    </div>
  </div>

</div><!-- /main -->

<script>
// ---- LOGO ----
(function(){
  var b64='';
  document.getElementById('logo').src='data:image/jpeg;base64,'+b64;
})();

// ---- NAVEGAÇÃO ----
function showPage(id,navEl){
  document.querySelectorAll('.page').forEach(p=>p.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(n=>n.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('page-'+id).classList.add('active');
  if(navEl)navEl.classList.add('active');
}

function toggleChip(el){el.classList.toggle('sel');}

// ---- DADOS ----
var quotes=[
  {t:'"Você não precisa controlar seus pensamentos. Você só precisa parar de deixá-los controlar você."',a:'— Dan Millman'},
  {t:'"A respiração é a ponte que liga a vida à consciência."',a:'— Thich Nhat Hanh'},
  {t:'"Cuide da sua mente como cuida do seu corpo."',a:'— Dalai Lama'},
  {t:'"Cada momento de calma que você cria é uma vitória."',a:'— SOS'},
  {t:'"A tranquilidade não é ausência de tempestades, mas a capacidade de atravessá-las."',a:'— Desconhecido'},
];
var sidebarQ=['"A calma é uma forma de sabedoria."','"Cada respiração é um recomeço."','"Você é mais forte do que pensa."'];
var moodLabels={1:'Muito mal',2:'Muito mal',3:'Mal',4:'Mal',5:'Neutro',6:'Razoável',7:'Bem',8:'Bem',9:'Muito bem',10:'Excelente'};
var selectedMood=0;

// ---- INIT HOME ----
(function(){
  var n=new Date(),h=n.getHours();
  var g=h<12?'Bom dia ☀':h<18?'Boa tarde 🌤':'Boa noite 🌙';
  document.getElementById('greeting').textContent=g;
  document.getElementById('home-date').textContent=n.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR',{weekday:'long',day:'numeric',month:'long',year:'numeric'});
  var q=quotes[Math.floor(Math.random()*quotes.length)];
  document.getElementById('home-quote').textContent=q.t;
  document.getElementById('home-author').textContent=q.a;
  document.getElementById('sq').textContent=sidebarQ[Math.floor(Math.random()*sidebarQ.length)];
})();

// ---- MOOD BAR ----
(function(){
  var bar=document.getElementById('mood-bar');
  for(var i=1;i<=10;i++){
    (function(v){
      var b=document.createElement('div');
      b.className='mood-btn';b.textContent=v;
      b.onclick=function(){
        document.querySelectorAll('.mood-btn').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('sel'));
        this.classList.add('sel');selectedMood=v;
        document.getElementById('mood-feedback').textContent=moodLabels[v]||'';
      };
      bar.appendChild(b);
    })(i);
  }
})();

// ---- CHECK-IN ----
var checkins=[
  {date:'14 Jun',mood:7,emotions:['Ansioso','Motivado'],ctx:'Reunião importante hoje'},
  {date:'13 Jun',mood:6,emotions:['Cansado','Grato'],ctx:''},
  {date:'12 Jun',mood:8,emotions:['Tranquilo'],ctx:'Dia produtivo'},
];
function renderCheckins(){
  var el=document.getElementById('checkin-hist');
  el.innerHTML=checkins.slice(0,5).map(c=>`
    <div class="diary-entry">
      <div class="d-date"><span class="d-day">${c.mood}</span>${c.date}</div>
      <div class="d-text">
        ${c.emotions.map(e=>`<span class="d-tag">${e}</span>`).join('')}
        ${c.ctx?`<div style="margin-top:4px;color:#8A9BAA;font-size:12px">${c.ctx}</div>`:''}
      </div>
    </div>`).join('');
}
renderCheckins();
function saveCheckin(){
  if(!selectedMood){document.getElementById('mood-feedback').textContent='Selecione seu humor primeiro';document.getElementById('mood-feedback').style.color='#A32D2D';return;}
  var chips=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#emotion-chips .chip.sel')).map(c=>c.textContent);
  var ctx=document.getElementById('checkin-ctx').value;
  var d=new Date();
  checkins.unshift({date:d.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR',{day:'2-digit',month:'short'}),mood:selectedMood,emotions:chips,ctx:ctx});
  document.querySelectorAll('.mood-btn').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('sel'));
  document.querySelectorAll('#emotion-chips .chip').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('sel'));
  document.getElementById('checkin-ctx').value='';
  selectedMood=0;document.getElementById('mood-feedback').textContent='';
  var ok=document.getElementById('checkin-ok');ok.style.display='block';
  setTimeout(()=>ok.style.display='none',2500);
  renderCheckins();
}

// ---- DIÁRIO ----
var diaryEntries=[
  {date:'14/06',text:'Hoje foi intenso. A pressão do projeto está aumentando, mas consegui respirar fundo e continuar.',tags:['trabalho','desafio']},
  {date:'12/06',text:'Tive uma conversa ótima com a equipe. Me sinto mais apoiado.',tags:['relações','conquista']},
];
function renderDiary(){
  var el=document.getElementById('diary-entries');
  el.innerHTML=diaryEntries.map(e=>`
    <div class="diary-entry">
      <div class="d-date"><span class="d-day">${e.date.split('/')[0]}</span>/${e.date.split('/')[1]}</div>
      <div class="d-text">
        <div>${e.text}</div>
        <div style="margin-top:4px">${e.tags.map(t=>`<span class="d-tag">${t}</span>`).join('')}</div>
      </div>
    </div>`).join('');
}
renderDiary();
function saveDiary(){
  var txt=document.getElementById('diary-txt').value.trim();
  if(!txt)return;
  var tags=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#diary-tag-chips .chip.sel')).map(c=>c.textContent);
  var d=new Date();
  diaryEntries.unshift({date:`${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}/${String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}`,text:txt,tags:tags});
  document.getElementById('diary-txt').value='';
  document.querySelectorAll('#diary-tag-chips .chip').forEach(c=>c.classList.remove('sel'));
  renderDiary();
}

// ---- RESPIRAÇÃO ----
var techs={
  '478':{phases:['Inhale','Segure','Exhale'],durs:[4,7,8],lbls:['Respire fundo pelo nariz','Segure o ar com calma','Solte devagar pela boca']},
  'box':{phases:['Inhale','Segure','Exhale','Segure'],durs:[4,4,4,4],lbls:['Inhale lentamente','Segure','Exhale completamente','Segure vazio']},
  'calm':{phases:['Inhale','Exhale'],durs:[5,7],lbls:['Respire fundo','Solte devagar — mais que o dobro']},
};
var curTech='478',bRunning=false,bPhase=0,bCount=0,bCycles=0,bTimer=null;
function selTech(id){
  curTech=id;
  document.querySelectorAll('.tech-card').forEach(c=>c.classList.remove('sel'));
  document.getElementById('tech-'+id).classList.add('sel');
  resetBreath();
}
function resetBreath(){
  clearInterval(bTimer);bRunning=false;bPhase=0;bCount=0;bCycles=0;
  document.getElementById('bbtn').textContent='Iniciar';
  document.getElementById('bphase').textContent='Pronto para começar';
  document.getElementById('bcount').textContent='—';
  document.getElementById('binst').textContent='Pressione iniciar quando estiver confortável';
  document.getElementById('bcircle').textContent='Pronto';
  document.getElementById('bcircle').style.transform='scale(1)';
  document.getElementById('bcycles').textContent='0';
}
function toggleBreath(){
  if(bRunning){clearInterval(bTimer);bRunning=false;document.getElementById('bbtn').textContent='Continuar';return;}
  bRunning=true;document.getElementById('bbtn').textContent='Pausar';
  runPhase();
}
function runPhase(){
  var t=techs[curTech];
  var ph=t.phases[bPhase],dur=t.durs[bPhase],lbl=t.lbls[bPhase];
  document.getElementById('bphase').textContent=ph;
  document.getElementById('binst').textContent=lbl;
  document.getElementById('bcircle').textContent=ph;
  document.getElementById('bcircle').style.transform=ph==='Inhale'?'scale(1.25)':ph==='Exhale'?'scale(0.85)':'scale(1.05)';
  bCount=dur;document.getElementById('bcount').textContent=bCount;
  bTimer=setInterval(()=>{
    bCount--;document.getElementById('bcount').textContent=bCount;
    if(bCount<=0){
      clearInterval(bTimer);
      bPhase=(bPhase+1)%t.phases.length;
      if(bPhase===0){bCycles++;document.getElementById('bcycles').textContent=bCycles;}
      if(bRunning)runPhase();
    }
  },1000);
}

// ---- GRÁFICO ----
(function(){
  var data=[{d:'Seg',h:6},{d:'Ter',h:7},{d:'Qua',h:9},{d:'Qui',h:7},{d:'Sex',h:8},{d:'Sáb',h:5},{d:'Dom',h:7}];
  var el=document.getElementById('mood-chart');
  el.innerHTML=data.map(d=>`
    <div class="chart-col">
      <div class="chart-bar" style="height:${Math.round(d.h/10*68)}px"></div>
      <div class="chart-day">${d.d}</div>
    </div>`).join('');
})();

// ---- BIBLIOTECA ----
var articles=[
  {title:'Como identificar os sinais de burnout',prev:'Aprenda a reconhecer o esgotamento antes que se agrave.',cat:'burnout',icon:'ti-flame'},
  {title:'Técnicas cognitivas para ansiedade no trabalho',prev:'Estratégias baseadas na TCC para lidar com pensamentos intrusivos.',cat:'estresse',icon:'ti-brain'},
  {title:'Comunicação não-violenta com a equipe',prev:'Como expressar necessidades sem criar conflitos.',cat:'relacoes',icon:'ti-users'},
  {title:'Método Pomodoro para mentes ansiosas',prev:'Adapte a técnica de produtividade para reduzir sobrecarga mental.',cat:'produtividade',icon:'ti-clock'},
  {title:'Mindfulness em 5 minutos no trabalho',prev:'Práticas rápidas que cabem no intervalo do café.',cat:'estresse',icon:'ti-leaf'},
  {title:'Limites saudáveis no ambiente profissional',prev:'Aprender a dizer não é uma habilidade essencial de autocuidado.',cat:'relacoes',icon:'ti-shield'},
];
var libFilter='all';
function renderLib(){
  var el=document.getElementById('lib-list');
  var f=libFilter==='all'?articles:articles.filter(a=>a.cat===libFilter);
  el.innerHTML=f.map(a=>`
    <div class="art-card">
      <div class="art-icon"><i class="ti ${a.icon}"></i></div>
      <div>
        <div class="art-title">${a.title}</div>
        <div class="art-prev">${a.prev}</div>
        <span class="art-cat">${a.cat}</span>
      </div>
    </div>`).join('');
}
renderLib();
function filterLib(el,cat){
  document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));
  el.classList.add('active');libFilter=cat;renderLib();
}

// ---- METAS ----
var goals=[
  {text:'Fazer check-in emocional diariamente',done:true},
  {text:'Praticar respiração 3x por semana',done:true},
  {text:'Ler 1 artigo da biblioteca por semana',done:false},
  {text:'Escrever no diário 2x por semana',done:false},
];
function renderGoals(){
  var el=document.getElementById('goals-list');
  el.innerHTML=goals.map((g,i)=>`
    <div class="goal-item">
      <div class="goal-check${g.done?' done':''}" onclick="toggleGoal(${i})">${g.done?'✓':''}</div>
      <div class="goal-text${g.done?' done':''}">${g.text}</div>
    </div>`).join('');
  var done=goals.filter(g=>g.done).length;
  var pct=goals.length?Math.round(done/goals.length*100):0;
  document.getElementById('gp-label').textContent=`${done} / ${goals.length} concluídas`;
  document.getElementById('gp-bar').style.width=pct+'%';
}
renderGoals();
function toggleGoal(i){goals[i].done=!goals[i].done;renderGoals();}
function addGoal(){
  var inp=document.getElementById('new-goal');
  var txt=inp.value.trim();if(!txt)return;
  goals.push({text:txt,done:false});inp.value='';renderGoals();
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
